questions.question: Why does a blog project host a sophisticated AI research agent platform (.trae/skills) with AST analyzers, graph algorithms, and LLM pipelines?

genesis.observation: The repo contains 4 AI agent skills (enterprise-research-agent, repo-research-v2, tidy-chatgpt-text) with 11-module analyzer pipeline, while the primary function is a static blog

questions.question: Why do many weekly posts contain empty link entries (markdown [text]() with no URL), and what does that reveal about the editorial workflow?

genesis.observation: 2026Jul27.md has 332 lines but ~80% of links are empty []() placeholders, suggesting template-first curation where URLs are filled asynchronously

questions.question: What editorial process ensures weekly publishing consistency across 157 posts spanning 3 years without gaps?

genesis.observation: Posts follow strict weekly schedule from 2023Jul31 to 2026Jul27 with predictable naming YYYYMonDD.md, suggesting an automated or templated pipeline

questions.question: Why are blog post filenames date-based IDs (2026Jul27.md) rather than semantic slugs, and what are the trade-offs?

genesis.observation: Unlike typical blogs with slug-based URLs, all 157 posts use date-based filenames with no human-readable identifiers, yet titles are semantic

questions.question: How does the content strategy balance AI/LLM coverage vs broader engineering topics across the weekly cadence?

genesis.observation: Topics span Claude, DeepSeek, MCP SDK, Ollama, Angular, Node.js, C++, streaming, and academic research—not purely AI-focused despite the 'AI-first' impression

questions.question: Why does an Astro static blog use React islands (Search.tsx, Card.tsx) instead of pure Astro components for interactivity?

genesis.observation: Search.tsx and Card.tsx are React 19 components using Fuse.js and useState, while most UI is Astro-native—creating a hybrid architecture

questions.question: How does the bilingual content (Chinese titles with English post bodies) impact SEO, sitemap generation, and RSS feed design?

genesis.observation: config.ts sets lang='en' while many posts have Chinese titles/content; sitemap and RSS are generated through Astro integrations but lang may misrepresent content

questions.question: Why does a personal blog need a multi-stage CI pipeline with Jampack optimization and a research-agent-check CI job?

genesis.observation: Build pipeline runs Astro SSG → Jampack image optimization → GitHub Pages, plus a separate CI job running research.mjs benchmark and eval on every push
